run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the minimum difference between max and min of all K-size subsets
test_f_gold: test f_gold with an array, its length N, and subset size K to verify minimum difference
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which sorts an array and computes the minimum max-min difference across K-size windows
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand the sliding window approach for finding minimum subset difference
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array by using a sorted copy instead
